what_this_does_not_establish: v3 is an internally consistent benchmark artifact of constructed examples drawn from a limited legal corpus, labelled by one non-lawyer. It is not evidence of legal accuracy, statutory coverage, or production readiness. Two of its three buckets cannot measure the axis the gate reports for them: dropped_qualifier holds no positives, so its F1 is undefined; paraphrase holds no negatives, so its false-accept count is vacuous. No score from it may be compared with any score taken before it, because those were measured on a generator rather than on a named artifact.
what_this_establishes: That the verifier cascade, run against a named and hash-verified artifact, did not regress on four axes: false accepts, F1, abstention, and per-bucket reporting.
